mechanism: Budesonide (CYP3A4 substrate) may inhibit metabolism of deutetrabenazine, potentially increasing deutetrabenazine exposure and risk of adverse effects including QT prolongation and tardive dyskinesia.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine side effects (sedation, parkinsonism, akathisia); consider ECG monitoring given deutetrabenazine's QT prolongation risk; adjust deutetrabenazine dose if necessary.
